summary.en: Seattle's muddy guitars and anti-hero stance.
summary.zh: 西雅图的泥泞吉他与反英雄姿态。

body.en: Grunge mixes Punk roughness with Hard Rock weight, rewriting mainstream rock's heroic narrative with alienated lyrics. Nirvana pushes it global and accelerates Alternative's commercialization.
body.zh: Grunge 混合 Punk 的粗糙与 Hard Rock 的重量，用疏离歌词改写主流摇滚的英雄叙事。Nirvana 把它推上全球舞台，也加速了 Alternative 的商业化。
